literal_meaning: যমের দ্বারা ধরা পড়া (being caught by Yam, the god of death)
figurative_meaning_en: To be in extreme distress or dire straits
example_sentences_in_bangla: আর্থিক সংকটে সে যমে ধরা পড়েছে।
দুর্ঘটনায় তার পরিবার যমে ধরা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is caught by Yam in financial crisis.
His family has been gripped by extreme misfortune after the accident.
history: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Yam (Yama) is the god of death who seizes souls after death, symbolizing ultimate suffering or ruin in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of inevitable doom, deeply embedded in Bengali expressions of hardship.
